Food hygiene issues
Mar 2021 • Couples
We were keen to try this café after seeing their page on FB so went for lunch and then purchased several items to take back home.

At lunch all seemed good until one of our orders, the avocado and…….. sandwich arrived completely missing the avocado. As there was no one serving upstairs I went to the counter and advised them and shortly after they brought a plate with some avocado on it for us to add, perhaps better service would have been to replace the sandwich.

After lunch we bought bread, buns and a loaf of banana bread and took this home with us.

At home we opened the cellophane the banana cake was wrapped in and cut two slices. I ate mine when my wife noticed movement in hers. Closer inspection revealed the cake had ants living in it. I checked the remaining cake and it was infested with live ants, from inside the wrapper.

Upon contacting the café ‘manager' and sending video of the ants in the cake she told us to return the cake to them for a refund. Advising we were not located that close she said they would collect it from us and refund the price of the cake. She even said that the ants would have come from us, despite the fact that it was wrapped by them in the café and no other products in the same bag were affected. It was clear all she wanted was to get the cake back and not at all concerned about customer service or our health given that we had clearly eaten live ants from their produce. Having lost confidence, or should I say, appetite, all we asked was for them to refund all the items we had purchased for takeaway but this was refused.

We have resealed the cake for inspection by the food hygiene administration following our complaint to them, along with the video footage. For ants to be infesting this cake it is clear this will not be a single incident and means the hygiene standards fall way below acceptable levels. Our advice is

Owner's R
Dear CLKKW - I note this is the first time the avocado issue comes up, that our the banana bread (which is sweet and moist) did not have any ants when you purchased it, and that that banana bread had been with you (we don't know where) for over 3 hours before you found ants in them. And yes, ants do get anywhere despite any wrapping. In response to this review we will simply paste below the response our of our founders have sent you on Saturday 27 March at 7:53pm (we keep all the screenshots on record), in response to your request of 'compensation' that we consider unjustified and abusive:
>>>> "Hello [your name, given that TripAdvisor does not allow personal details to be disclosed here]. This is [name of founder], one of the founders of Tartine. I have seen your exchanges with your team and the videos. I have also discussed with the manager of our shop in Binh Thanh. You have picked up the banana bread just after 2pm and contacted us at 5:22pm for ants on the banana bread. We have checked our stock and our store, and coukd not find any ants anywhere. In addition, we have a regular pest control and treatment happening here, and the most recent was this week. We are confident there was no ants in the banana bread when you picked it up. In a spirit of cooperation and because we are never happy seeing our customers not being able to enjoy the products we prepare with care and love, we have offered you to replace the banana bread. You are requesting a full refund of your purchase of not only the banana bread, but the other bread and buns you purchased (that you confirmed are fine) but you would keep all, as "compensation" and you are threatening to report this to the food adminstration authorities if we don't "compensate". I am shocked and don't understand the actual rational underlying you request and position. My number is 09[removed as per TripAdvisor policy] if you wish to explain more. Regards, Jerome"

reviews.review_text:
BillTuckerUS
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam51 contributions
0
Excellent Euro-American Food and Sourdough Bakery
Dec 2020
My wife and I have now visited the Binh Thanh branch twice, for brunch. She's had the soft-boiled eggs and the cheese steak sandwich, and I've had the eggs benedict and the English breakfast. One minor complaint - The eggs ben were made with prosciutto, which I thought made the dish a little too salty.

We discovered Tartine through purchasing their sourdough bread at a market near our house. I, a long time SF Bay Area resident, think Tartine sourdough actually has more flavor than the Acme sourdough baguette that I used to enjoy.

On our second trip, we ordered a banana bread loaf and asked them to cut us a couple of slices to eat there, before taking the rest home. It was just a little sweeter than I remember my late mother's banana bread being, but it was very good.

Overall, excellent food, at prices more reasonable than District 1.
